title: DDAY Simulator
author: kookslayer9000
selftext: Growing up I was obsessed with movies like saving private ryan and games like call of duty 2. I’m talking as a small child. I could barely read at the time but the subject of world war 2 and D-Day especially grabbed my attention more than trains even. Chat gpt 6 Astra all within VSC nothing external. Made a little dday sim, spent far too long dialing in the flow of the assault, ai, gunfire, details ect. Really happy with how the game flows and ai reacts to storming a beach on both sides. Not sure where to go from here as I’ve stormed the beach probably over 1000 times testing features during creation. Needs some kind of system that rewards replay-ability besides a unique beach landing every-time. There is also a German mode where you can man the guns and call in artillery but too lazy to include in video. Just some gameplay of an assault at different camera angles. Thanks for checking it out
